exposure: Implementation of a new management protocol for intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP)
cohort: 186 women with singleton pregnancies and ICP diagnosed before 36 weeks gestation with total bile acids >40 μmol/L
finding: Implementing a new management protocol for ICP, including early delivery between 36 and 37 weeks gestation, reduced the stillbirth rate in women with severe ICP without negatively impacting other maternal or neonatal outcomes.
